headlines.title: What’s fueling inflation? Fuel.
headlines.description: The final CPI report before the midterms is expected to reflect soaring energy costs compounded by higher airfares, pricier iPhones and rising car prices.

headlines.title: In heated Georgia Senate debate, Jon Ossoff says he won’t run for president in 2028
headlines.description: The Democratic incumbent pledged to serve a full term as he and challenger Rep. Mike Collins hit on similar themes as in their first debate last week.

headlines.title: Federal judge issues longer-term decision blocking Trump’s White House media ban
headlines.description: U.S. District Judge Timothy Kelly issued an injunction preventing CNN, Politico and MS NOW from being booted from the White House grounds until the case is decided.

headlines.title: Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer
headlines.description: The Vatican says surgery to remove a nodule from Pope Leo’s lung was successful. The 71-year-old leader of the Catholic Church was found to have what is the most common form of lung cancer. NBC News’ Anne Thompson reports.

headlines.title: Texas DA says ICE intentionally hit immigrant with a car and may have withheld evidence
headlines.description: Harris County DA Sean Teare told NBC News his office has collected multiple videos for its own investigation but isn’t getting cooperation from the federal government.

headlines.title: Bank of America ordered to pay historic $1.2 billion over alleged sanctions law violations
headlines.description: The fine is the third-highest penalty ever issued by the Treasury Department, which found that the bank failed to report billions in suspicious transactions.

headlines.title: Trump pardons two vehicle repair shop owners during Alaska rally
headlines.description: During his rally in Alaska, President Trump pardoned Zachary Czuback and Patrick Fleming, co-owners of a vehicle repair shop in Anchorage. Both pleaded guilty in 2022 to violating the Clean Air Act by tampering with federally mandated and monitored devices that tracked vehicles’ diesel emissions.
